study type: Program Development and Feasibility Study with Pilot Test
exposure: Comprehensive structured program for managing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
outcome: Reduction in future Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) risk (program aim)
cohort: The study involved the development of a program for Chinese women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), with a pilot test including eight women with GDM.
finding: The pilot study confirmed the feasibility and acceptability of the developed comprehensive structured program among women with GDM.
